optimizedDescription.value: Searches spec content across configured workspaces without code-graph dependency, with filtering, ranking, and optional summaries.

optimizedContext.value:
# Search Specs
## Rules
- `SearchSpecs.execute()` gets project structure via `ListWorkspaces`; calls each workspace `SpecRepository.search()` for substring matching; aggregates results; sorts descending by `score`.
- Non-empty `options.workspaces`: search matching configured workspace names only; silently ignore unknown names. Omitted/empty: search all workspaces.
- `options.includeSummary === true`: call `GetSpecMetadata.execute({ specId })` with default `if-needed` policy per result; use normalized `description` as `summary`. Never read repository metadata snapshot or `spec.md` directly. Omit `summary` when materialization yields no projection; do not fail search.
- `options.includeSummary` false/omitted: never include `summary`; never materialize metadata for result.
- Result fields: `workspace`, `path`, resolved `title` using `ListSpecs` resolution, repository `score`, repository `matches: SpecSearchMatch[]`; optional `summary` only under rule above.
- Per-workspace repository search errors: silently catch; omit failed workspace results; preserve others; never propagate individual I/O errors.
- No matches: return `[]`.
- `createSearchSpecs(config, options?)`: derive `SearchSpecsDeps` through `resolveSearchSpecsDeps(resolver)`, then delegate to canonical `createSearchSpecs(deps)`.
- `resolveSearchSpecsDeps(resolver)` resolves `listWorkspaces: ListWorkspaces` and `getMetadata: GetSpecMetadata`; must not resolve `hasher: ContentHasher` or `yaml: YamlSerializer`; sole use-case-specific config-bootstrap composition entry; factory must not reconstruct fs-shaped wiring inline.
## Constraints
- Depend on `ListWorkspaces` for consistent fallback-search project traversal.
- Return results sorted by descending relevance score.
